Malcolm, 2026-08-25: 'a professional medical beauty industry style explainer diagram to show the effects explained in this content section', matching the previously selected explainer diagrams.

WHAT IT REPLACES: skingenetix-matrixyl-serum-texture-closeup.jpg, a borrowed macro of serum texture. Same fault the copper-peptide f1 had — a photograph of the product argues nothing about the biology, and this is the one block on the page that is pure mechanism.

THE REFERENCE SET IS THE SIX SELECTED BLOCKS, not the briefs that produced them: copper-peptide-research f1/f2/f3 and matrixyl-3000-research f1/f2/f3, pulled from the live CDN and viewed together before anything was written. Note the selected winners DRIFTED from the r3 written spec: that spec called for vivid Clinical blue 014EB1 fibres, and what Malcolm actually chose on the Matrixyl set is a softer desaturated teal against peach-cream tissue. Follow what was selected, not what was specified.

HOUSE DEVICES CARRIED OVER: soft glossy CGI, luminous and high-key on a pale hazy gradient; a block of skin in cross-section at a low three-quarter angle so top surface and cut face are both visible; three legible strata (textured surface, a stack of rounded cells, a deep zone of long wavy fibre bundles); peach-cream tissue; teal-blue glossy fibres; shallow depth of field with the far edge dissolving into haze.

MECHANISM FIRST, STYLE SECOND — and here the mechanism INVERTS the house vocabulary. Every existing explainer on this store shows an active ARRIVING AND IMPROVING something: translucent spheres above the surface, slender light shafts descending, starburst glints at the point of arrival, copper beads. This block explains DAMAGE. That entire vocabulary is barred in slots A, B and D, because a picture of an active arriving under the heading 'What Causes Fine Lines & Wrinkles?' argues the opposite of the text. Slot C is the single exception and is handled below.

WHAT THE TEXT ACTUALLY CLAIMS, stated before the briefs so the four candidates are not interchangeable:
  1  Collagen and elastin breakdown — ~1% less collagen a year from about 25, 30-50% of total skin collagen gone by 50; the skin loses its ability to spring back.
  2  Repetitive muscle movement — every expression folds the skin; as the matrix weakens the fold stops recovering and becomes permanently etched.
  3  UV radiation — up to 80% of visible facial ageing; UVA penetrates to the dermis and generates free radicals that break collagen and elastin fibres.
  4  Glycation and dehydration — sugars attach to collagen forming AGEs, making fibres stiff and brittle; hyaluronic acid production drops roughly 50% by the 40s.

Four concepts, one per cause, so Malcolm chooses the ARGUMENT as well as the rendering. Only one image can go in the slot.

CENTRE-SAFE COMPOSITION IS A HARD CONSTRAINT, AND IT IS MEASURED. This block carries the longest copy on the page, so its row is TEXT-DRIVEN at every desktop width — confirmed by overriding the img height to 0 in the live DOM and reading grid-template-rows back, which returns exactly the live row height at all six widths. The image therefore never stretches the row whatever its aspect, but it does get cropped:

  390  -> 350 x 350  (1.000, stacked, no crop)
  1024 -> 452 x 808  (0.559)
  1100 -> 490 x 784  (0.625)
  1280 -> 580 x 792  (0.732)
  1440 -> 660 x 802  (0.823)
  1920 -> 708 x 778  (0.911)

The box is taller than square at every desktop width, so object-fit: cover fills the HEIGHT and crops the WIDTH. Full height always survives; horizontally a square master shows only the central 56% at 1024, 82% at 1440, 91% at 1920. So every brief below puts the event in the CENTRAL BAND and fills the outer fifth of each side with pale haze that can be lost without cost. A left-to-right gradient of degradation was rejected for exactly this reason — its two extremes are the first thing cropped. Degradation is centred instead.

MASTER IS SQUARE at 2048x2048. Non-square is barred here by the same rule that governs the rest of this section: the five sibling blocks are all square and a different aspect makes this one the odd one out. Square is also the only aspect that is pixel-perfect on mobile, where the box is exactly 1:1.

CLASS B, no reference images attached. The r3 and Matrixyl sets that Malcolm selected were both generated class B with the style carried entirely in the prompt, and it worked; attaching refs changes behaviour unevenly across six engines for no demonstrated gain.

All six suppliers, two candidates each — .claude/rules/website-imagery.md rule 1. FLUX.2 returns one per call regardless and is under-represented by design; it also invents printed graduation digits on anything glassware-like, so check its candidates at full size.

slots.title: A · collagen and elastin breakdown — the scaffold thins and the surface folds
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame and centred. Three strata are clearly legible from top to bottom: a thin outer layer with a fine irregular texture of soft interlocking plates; beneath it a stack of two or three rows of flattened rounded translucent cells; and below that an open deeper zone filled with long wavy bundles of glossy fibre running horizontally, curving and overlapping in loose parallel waves. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm and pale. The fibre bundles are a soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

AT THE CENTRE OF THE BLOCK the deep fibre zone is visibly DEPLETED: the bundles there are thin, sparse, widely spaced and dull, several of them slack and broken-ended, with open empty gaps between them where the network has given way. Toward the left and right edges of the block the same bundles are thick, densely packed, springy and softly lit, so the loss reads as a change within one continuous piece of tissue rather than two separate states.

DIRECTLY ABOVE THAT DEPLETED CENTRE THE SURFACE HAS SUNK INTO A SOFT VALLEY — a single smooth crease running across the top face of the block, the outer layer dipping and gently buckling into it, the cell rows beneath compressed and sagging toward the hollow, unsupported. Where the fibres are still dense the surface is smooth, taut and level.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge of the block dissolving into pale haze. The outer fifth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical rather than alarming.

slots.title: B · repetitive muscle movement — the fold recurs at one point and stops recovering
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, centred in the frame. Three strata are legible: a thin outer layer of fine interlocking plates; a stack of rounded translucent cells beneath it; and a deep zone of long glossy fibre bundles running horizontally in loose waves. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream. The fibre bundles are a soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

THE TOP SURFACE IS PINCHED INTO ONE DEEP FOLD at the centre of the block, the outer layer doubling over on itself and tucking down into a narrow groove, as though the whole block has been squeezed inward from both sides. The tissue on either side of the groove is bunched and raised into two soft rounded ridges pressing together.

DIRECTLY BENEATH THE GROOVE the structure shows the cost of that fold having happened over and over: the cell rows are crushed thin and pressed flat, and the fibre bundles below are sharply kinked and bent out of their smooth horizontal waves, several of them creased, flattened and frayed at the bend, thinner and duller than their neighbours. The bundles further out to the left and right remain thick, smooth and evenly waved.

A faint series of soft ghosted contour ridges runs parallel to the fold across the surface on both sides, the memory of the same crease forming again and again, fading out toward the edges.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. The outer fifth of the frame on the left and right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: C · UV photoaging — light penetrates to the dermis and the fibre network fragments
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, centred and occupying the lower two thirds of the frame. Three strata are legible: a thin outer layer of fine interlocking plates; a stack of rounded translucent cells; and a deep zone of long glossy fibre bundles running horizontally in loose waves. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream. The fibre bundles are a soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

FROM THE TOP OF THE FRAME A BROAD, DIFFUSE WASH OF PALE VIOLET-WHITE LIGHT FALLS ACROSS THE WHOLE WIDTH OF THE BLOCK — a wide even curtain of light, not a beam and not a spotlight, sinking down through the outer layer and through the cell rows and reaching deep into the fibre zone below, growing fainter as it goes but clearly arriving among the bundles.

WHERE THAT LIGHT REACHES THE FIBRES THE NETWORK IS COMING APART: the bundles there are broken into short disconnected segments with ragged, frayed, splayed ends, curling and drifting slightly apart, their colour washed out to a pale dull grey-taupe, the smooth horizontal waves lost. The damage is heaviest in the centre of the block where the light is strongest and eases gradually toward the deepest and outermost corners, where the bundles are still whole, teal and smoothly waved.

The top surface above the fragmented zone has slackened into a shallow soft depression, unsupported from below.

Soft diffuse light overall, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. The outer fifth of the frame left and right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, cool and clinical.

slots.title: D · glycation and dehydration — the bundles cross-link, stiffen and lose their spring
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, centred in the frame. Three strata are legible: a thin outer layer of fine interlocking plates; a stack of rounded translucent cells; and a deep zone of long glossy fibre bundles running horizontally. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream. The fibre bundles are a soft desaturated teal-blue, glassy and translucent.

AT THE CENTRE OF THE DEEP ZONE THE BUNDLES HAVE BEEN LOCKED TOGETHER: dozens of tiny hard amber-honey nodules have formed at every point where one fibre crosses another, fusing them into a rigid seized-up mesh. The fibres held in that mesh have lost their soft horizontal waves and run straight, taut and angular, dulled to a stiff greyish teal with a brittle glassy sheen and a few snapped ends. Around the outside of that seized zone the bundles are still supple, plump, smoothly waved and clearly teal, and the transition between the two is gradual.

THE CELL ROWS ABOVE THE SEIZED ZONE ARE SHRUNKEN AND FLATTENED, their plump roundness gone, packed tightly with narrow gaps between them and noticeably drier and more matte than the glossy cells further out to the sides.

The top surface above them is thinner and has settled into a shallow crease, the outer layer looking tight and inelastic.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. The outer fifth of the frame left and right is empty pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.
